rule.note: Mandatory written agency policy, mandatory incident report on every DV call regardless of arrest, mandatory victim information card, mandatory form fields — all captured in current/text.txt

reasoning.note: § 13701 addresses officer discretion that historically resulted in no documentation and no accountability in DV calls; mandatory reporting eliminates the escape hatch that allowed officers to leave DV scenes without a record — documented in historical_chain.md and context.md

historical_loss.note: Pre-§ 13701 era: DV calls treated as family matters, no arrest, no report, perpetrators knew they faced no consequence; Minneapolis Domestic Violence Experiment (1984) demonstrated arrest deterred re-offense but California agencies resisted — documented in historical_chain.md
